items.summary: We had a blast engaging with the Warframe community in Seoul, South Korea! In addition to hosting the latest stop on our TennoVIP world tour, we also streamed Devstream 197 live with the assistance of host/translator Will Chobra, bringing y
items.content:
We had a blast engaging with the Warframe community in Seoul, South Korea! In addition to hosting the latest stop on our TennoVIP world tour, we also streamed Devstream 197 live with the assistance of host/translator Will Chobra, bringing you the very first detailed look at our next update, Iceblade of Narin (coming September 23). If you missed the broadcast and haven't yet had the chance to check out the VOD or our Devstream Overview, we've assembled the biggest highlights from the show for you here:

See our 66th Warframe (Narin) in action, learn about our big plans for Banshee (including a Rework and Login Reward), and get your first taste of an all-new 6-player game mode called Glacial Defiance. We also announced an upcoming once-in-a-lifetime Epoch Operation to help you prepare for Tau later in the year, and revealed the exciting developments coming soon to Soulframe. Learn more about Iceblade of Narin here: https://warframe.com/iceblade-of-narin. Want more? Watch Devstream 197 in its entirety here or check out our full Devstream 197 Overview.

Warframe will take players to Tau, an entirely new solar system. But in what has become the norm for the long-running multiplayer game, creative director Rebecca Ford is looking backward and forward at the same time.

“The impossible task of anyone working on Warframe is choosing when to go new or choosing when to revisit,” Ford told Polygon on a recent call. The team is laying groundwork for Tau at a breakneck pace. Warframe ’s fall update, The Iceblade of Narin will introduce a new Warframe and in-game hub on Sept. 23.

Then, on Oct. 15 a special event called Epoch Operation: Tau will launch, which is something that I will show to people who don’t know much about Warframe so that I can witness their bafflement (it involves piloting a skyscraper-sized spaceship that looks like a large nude humanoid).

As if that weren’t enough, the team is also launching a new six-player cooperative game mode called Glacial Defiance, which is definitely not a raid.

“We had raids. They lived, they died, they're gone,” said Ford. “We are auditioning for a role of six-player, slightly demanding gameplay. Do you show up?”

Warframe ’s raids, officially known as Trials, were retired in 2018. At the time, design director Pablo Alonso explained that maintaining the game mode was a massive effort and timesink for the dev team — and that not enough players were actually engaging with it. Those who did though, seem to be diehards.

“There are players that know the old Warframe raids that stay around and talk about them to this day,” Ford said. Warframe has also become the de facto home for refugees from Destiny and Destiny 2 . In Warframe they’re finding cool weapons, zippy gameplay, and probably less toxicity. But the challenge the Warframe devs face is, ironically, a lack of challenge. High-level players with a mind for synergy can sweep through missions in a matter of minutes, carrying lesser ones to the finish line on a wave of neon explosions.

Image: Digital Extremes Is this awesome? Absolutely. But there is presumably a growing contingent of people who want their dopamine rush served with a side of strategic teamwork.

“The selfish tangent to this, which is both incriminating and honest, is I have a group of friends I play Deadlock with and we lament that there's nothing for us to do in Warframe because we have to leave two people out all the time,” Ford said. “So we'll see — is there a social niche for this? Are there groups of six players that want to do some Warframe stuff together that can't right now? And the answer to all those questions will be who knows, please be patient with us.”

In the two years that I’ve been playing Warframe , Digital Extremes has introduced multiple new Warframes, story quests, and now a solar system. In that same time, they have redone facial animations that date back to 2015, and periodically revamp older Warframes to bring their kits in line with the game’s modern, free-flowing gameplay. Not all the changes have been well-received in the moment: A horror mode called Follie’s Hunt proved destabilizing for a player community used to melting enemies with ease.

Image: Digital Extremes “I would say that was one of the low points of the year so far, which is great, which means we've only gone up since then,” said Ford.

Another adds more missions for the Railjack, a spaceship whose dogfight gameplay has been divisive. Revisiting it, said Ford, was “a dangerous thing for any Warframe dev to do.” Every change is a gamble — but a bold necessity — in a live-service game.

“The harshest reality check is when people disagree with your definition of fun for what I would call ‘our game,’ but the community would say, ‘No, no, this is actually our game, you make it for us,’” Ford said, laughing. “And we're like, ‘Damn, they got us again!’ Any developer who accidentally or intentionally makes a live service game must experience the ritual or the witchcraft that separates the self from the service. You always wish you had more time. You always wish you had more resources, but you need to deliver something.”

items.title: Devstream 197 Overview
items.summary: Our next update is coming September 23! Live from Seoul, we lifted the lid on Iceblade of Narin, which brings you its titular sword dancer Warframe, the six-player Glacial Defiance game mode and chillingly challenging Entropic Eximus enemie
items.content:
Our next update is coming September 23!

Live from Seoul, we lifted the lid on Iceblade of Narin, which brings you its titular sword dancer Warframe, the six-player Glacial Defiance game mode and chillingly challenging Entropic Eximus enemies waiting aboard the Zariman Ten Zero. Iceblade of Narin will also include the highly anticipated Qorvex Basilica and Banshee Threnodia Collections, as well as QoL improvements to Operator/Drifter hair shaders and an expansion to the Riven system. Banshee fans can also look forward to her long-awaited Rework, which you can test out for yourself by earning a FREE Banshee login Reward between September 23 and October 7. We also unveiled the upcoming, once-in-a-lifetime in-game event, Epoch Operation: Taubound. Check out our complete overview for details on all of this, and more!

items.title: Citrine Prime Access Coming Soon
items.summary: Shine on with a diamond’s spellbinding purpose once Citrine Prime enters Prime Access on September 23 ! Lavish Orokin gold complements every perfect cut of this jeweled bastion’s signature Prime Weapons and exclusive Prime Accessories, inst
items.content:
Shine on with a diamond’s spellbinding purpose once Citrine Prime enters Prime Access on September 23! Lavish Orokin gold complements every perfect cut of this jeweled bastion’s signature Prime Weapons and exclusive Prime Accessories, instilling those fortunate enough to witness her luminescence with unshakeable resolve. Make your Arsenal shimmer with instant access and get the Prime items of your choice by selecting from the Weapons, Prime, Complete and Accessories Packs — which depends on your platform and preferences. Additionally, you can earn Citrine Prime and her signature Prime Weapons in-game by collecting and cracking-open Void Relics!

Citrine Prime Access includes:

Citrine Prime

The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.

Steflos Prime

This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime’s signature shotgun.

Corufell Prime

Corufell Prime’s golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

Citrine Prime Accessories

  • Sphatika Prime Syandana
  • Alumeti Prime Sugatra
  • Prismatic Gem Prime Decoration
  • Spinele Prime Facial Accessory
  • Spinele Prime Earpiece
  • Spinele Prime Oculus
-- Note: there’s no better value than with the Citrine Prime Access Complete Pack, which includes the Citrine Prime Warframe, her Prime Weapons and Accessories, as well as some Platinum.

What are Primes?

When you require the finest and most powerful armaments, only Primes will do. Exquisitely gilded, every Prime Warframe, Weapon and item exists in its purest form — just as the Orokin intended. If you're new to Warframe, you can learn more about the Prime Access Program by visiting our official FAQs page and watching our community video guide below:

items.title: Banshee Login Reward Starting September 23!
items.summary: The September 23 release of Iceblade of Narin gives Banshee fans three huge reasons to perk up their ears. If you've enjoyed playing with her in the past, or want to wield her sound-based Abilities for the first time, you definitely don't w
items.content:
The September 23 release of Iceblade of Narin gives Banshee fans three huge reasons to perk up their ears. If you've enjoyed playing with her in the past, or want to wield her sound-based Abilities for the first time, you definitely don't want to sleep through our next update.

FREE Login Reward

Log in any time between September 23 and October 7 and you'll receive a FREE base Banshee Warframe, which means you can experience these highly-anticipated enhancements for yourself, regardless of Mastery Rank or experience level. We'll even include a free, built Forma for extra freedom when testing her new and improved Abilities. Want to invite a new friend to join you in the Origin System? Use your unique code and nab extra Rewards for both of you – your friend will get to enjoy a free Banshee, as well! For more details on our Iceblade of Narin update, visit our official website here.

Banshee Rework

The sonic Warframe has long been known for her capacity to vastly increase the damage of virtually any weapon you might add to your Loadout. And now, she can crank up the volume easier than ever before. With improved synergies across her kit, increased survivability and an overall QoL bump, she's now more Tenno-friendly and fun to use whatever your level of experience. For more information, watch the full Dev Workshop:

Banshee Threnodia

Lament the spirits of the dead with the baleful Banshee Threnodia Skin and corresponding Collection of mournful Customizations. The stark visage of this gorgeous apparition brings a gothically gaunt aesthetic to the scream queen – a sensuous feast for the eyes and ears.

items.title: Iceblade of Narin arrives September 23!
items.summary: Return to the Zariman and master a new Warframe as deadly as a winter blizzard when Iceblade of Narin launches on all platforms September 23! Log in between Sept. 23 and Oct. 7 to also receive a free Banshee Warframe as a login reward. Watc
items.content:
Return to the Zariman and master a new Warframe as deadly as a winter blizzard when Iceblade of Narin launches on all platforms September 23! Log in between Sept. 23 and Oct. 7 to also receive a free Banshee Warframe as a login reward. Watch the Iceblade of Narin Gameplay Trailer, featuring voiceover from Choi Han:

Narin, Sword Dancer Warframe

Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes. See more of Narin's Abilities in action:

Entropic Eximus

New Eximus enemies stalk the halls of the Zariman. Your Operator can chip away at their health, but your best option is to enhance your Melee Damage at the Yuvan Peak. Entropic Eximus enemies may drop Entropic Kuva, which you can use to trade with Cephalon Melica for rewards like Blueprints to craft Narin!

Yuvan Peak

Visit the dark side of Earth and enter a brand-new social Relay! At this spectacular mountain summit, you'll find Narin's Crest – and the Duelist Warframe's legendary sword encased firmly in the ice. Who will be the first to remove Narin's Iceblade?

Melica's Lab

A previously-unknown area has been discovered aboard the Zariman Ten Zero, prompting the appearance of resilient new Entropic Eximus enemies. Help Cephalon Melica defeat them to sever a dormant (but growing) connection to the Man in the Wall.

Riven System Changes

With the launch of Iceblade of Narin, you will be able to preserve specific Riven traits during rerolls using Kuva! We've also introduced Riven Splicers which can be utilized via the Mod Segment in your Orbiter and allow you to combine two Riven traits into a new one from a special pool of possibilities.

TennoGen Iceblade

The latest Customizations borne from the Warframe community include unique new fashions inspired by Necramechs and the Grineer Worm Queen. There's also a flowery new helmet for Citrine, just in time for her turn in Prime Access! -- But that's not all Tenno! Explore everything coming with Iceblade of Narin on September 23, including Citrine Prime Access, new Customizations for Banshee and Qorvex, and much more: warframe.com

items.title: Epoch Operation: Taubound
items.summary: Arturos and Zioa have lain dormant long enough: the time to assume control of your Vessel is almost at hand. With new worlds and possibilities beyond the Origin System closer than ever, your window to prepare for the journey to Tau begins n
items.content:
Arturos and Zioa have lain dormant long enough: the time to assume control of your Vessel is almost at hand. With new worlds and possibilities beyond the Origin System closer than ever, your window to prepare for the journey to Tau begins now, ahead of a never-before-seen, once in a lifetime Epoch Operation this October.

WHAT IS THE OPERATION?

Epoch Operation: Taubound will open a path to the Tau System with help from the Sentient Mothership, Praghasa. Facilitating your travels will require an extraordinary amount of energy on her part, so you will need to collect fuel to provide the strength she needs. Playing as your Warframe, you will need to visit Mission nodes across Eris to collect Moonflesh for Praghasa. In exchange for this viscous resource, she will offer a number of event-exclusive Rewards, as well as daily login messages for the duration of the Operation. This event calls for the collective participation of Tenno from across the entire community.

WHEN IS IT?

Epoch Operation: Taubound begins October 15 and will run for one month only, concluding on November 17.

HOW DO I PARTICIPATE?

Completing any Mission on Eris will provide Moonflesh, which can be traded to Praghasa for unique, event-exclusive Rewards. Users who interact with Praghasa will also get special, daily narrative updates that will not be repeated in-game after this event ends. Note: All Tenno who have completed Vor's Prize will be able to access Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound. The normal Star Chart and Junction requirements will be lifted for this event.

WHAT IF I MISS IT?

There will be no reruns of Epoch Operation: Taubound. This is a unique and one-time-only event. You will not be able to visit Praghasa for her Epoch Operation dialogue or Rewards again once it is concluded.

WHAT ABOUT MY VESSEL?

Separate from Epoch Operation: Taubound, you will also find a new Tau Prologue Quest added to your Codex starting on October 15. This Quest is a permanent new addition to the Warframe Codex that will remain in place even after Epoch Operation: Taubound ends and can be completed at your leisure. While it is narratively connected to the limited-time event, it is not related to the limited-time Rewards or dialogue found in this Epoch Operation. Note: You must complete The Hex and The Old Peace Quests to access the Tau Prologue Quest. This is not required to harvest Moonflesh as part of Epoch Operation: Taubound. If you would like to complete these Quests before Epoch Operation: Taubound, there's still time! Head over to our official Warframe Quest Guide for help navigating your way through Quest order. --

BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY

items.title: ‘Warframe’ & ‘Soulframe’ Updates Arriving This Fall
items.summary: Live from South Korea from their TennoVIP Community Event, developer Digital Extremes talked up a storm about their coming 'Warframe' and 'Soulframe'
items.content:
Mobile News Nintendo PC PlayStation Xbox Genghis Husameddin

Live from South Korea from their TennoVIP Community Event, developer Digital Extremes talked up a storm about their coming ‘Warframe’ and ‘Soulframe’ updates scheduled for this Fall. Warframe’s next major update, “Iceblade of Narin”, is set to arrive free on all platforms 23 September, with new details showcased for the 66th Warframe, Narin, alongside a first-look at new six-player squad missions, a new relay hub and enemy variant, Citrine Prime Access, and a once-in-a-lifetime in-game community event – Epoch Operation: Taubound (launching 15 October) – for players to prepare for the arrival of Warframe: Tau later this year. Additionally, the game will be launching on the Samsung Galaxy storefront very soon. Soulframe players tuning in were treated to new details around Preludes 16, a free update arriving mid-September that introduces wolf cub bonding, fishing, and dynamic weather changes among other slick new additions.

Return to the Zariman shipwreck and uncover the lost secret of Narin, the 66th Warframe, in the Iceblade of Narin update, arriving free all platforms September 23:

Discover new missions, locations, enemies, resources and rewards:

Heed the call of Tau’s beckoning and prepare for Epoch Operation: Taubound , a once-in-a-lifetime in-game community event arriving October 15:

Polish off the Foundry for the prismatic arrival of Citrine Prime Access, arriving alongside the Iceblade of Narin update September 23:

Listen for the piercing echo of Banshee’s rework and take advantage of a free login reward, plus new Deluxe cosmetics and TennoGen:

Warframe continues to become more accessible with its release on the Samsung Galaxy Store September 23:

Soulframe Preludes 16: Of Hook & Hound arrives free in mid-September:

Need to take the Fashion Frame game IRL? Warframe is extending its capsule collection collaboration with fashion house ARK/8 to offer fans around the world an opportunity to secure slick new apparel inspired by Jade Shadows: Constellations and other aspects of Warframe . Available online at warframe.ark8.net and at ARK/8’s physical retail location in Los Angeles on September 9, the capsule collection offers apparel featuring Garuda, Ash, Loki, Mag, Rhino, and of course, Excalibur.

Warframe is available across PC via Warframe.com /Steam (Windows & Linux via Proton), Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch consoles, iOS, and Android devices. Full cross-save and crossplay are supported across all platforms. Soulframe is available in Early Access form on PC via Soulframe.com, currently for paid pack members.

Enjoying DayOne ? Do us a favour, and make us a ‘ Preferred Source on Google ‘ – that way, you’ll only be delivered more gaming coverage from our team.

There’s plenty of ways to become a part of DayOne. Head over and let us know your thoughts in the Day O ne Forums , the perfect place to chat about games if you’re a little more old-school and prefer things in a longform form, and if you mainly play on PC, join our Steam Community to connect with other members and maybe make some new friends!

Prefer the chaos of live and fast moving conversation? Come and make some noise in the lively DayOne Community Discord Server instead. If you’re rocking a DayOne Membership, both places give special access for our supporters, and you’ll unlock a ton of exclusive content, just for you.

items.title: Banshee Prime and Mirage Prime enter Prime Resurgence
items.summary: Acoustic authority or dazzling deceit — which will you choose, Tenno? Prime Resurgence grants access to two of the Origin System’s most powerful Warframes. Banshee Prime If there ever was a siren song to herald the end, it would undoubtedly
items.content:
Acoustic authority or dazzling deceit — which will you choose, Tenno? Prime Resurgence grants access to two of the Origin System’s most powerful Warframes.

Banshee Prime

If there ever was a siren song to herald the end, it would undoubtedly emanate from Banshee Prime. Control the battlefield with her extraordinary ultrasonic abilities that can pinpoint an enemy’s position and exploit their various weaknesses through even the faintest vibration. If you’re all about silencing a crowd, then Banshee Prime might just be the Warframe for you.

Mirage Prime

Deception is an art, and Mirage Prime is a preeminent scholar on the matter. Master manipulation through her utterly mystifying stagecraft, harnessing photokinetic powers that create mirror images and ensnare enemies in lethal traps. There’s no question that Mirage Prime is ideal for anyone that loves to put on a show.

items.title: Operation Plague Star 2026
items.summary: Operation: Plague Star descends on the Plains of Eidolon once more from September 9 to September 23, across all platforms. Steal toxin from Councilor Vay Hek and the Grineer, destroy the boil and save Cetus before the Infestation can grow o
items.content:
Operation: Plague Star descends on the Plains of Eidolon once more from September 9 to September 23, across all platforms. Steal toxin from Councilor Vay Hek and the Grineer, destroy the boil and save Cetus before the Infestation can grow out of control.

What You Need To Do

Speak to Konzu in Cetus to undertake the Plague Star Bounty Complete the series of Bounty Missions to earn Operational Supply Standing for the Event Rewards

What You Need To Know

Bounties come with various requirements for completion that yield specific Rewards outlined below.

Tier 1:

Requirements: No prerequisites Rewards: Base Standing: 1,025 Bounty Bonus Completion: 25 bonus

Tier 2:

Requirements: 1x Eidolon Phylaxis + 1x Infested Catalyst Rewards: Base Standing: 3200 Bounty Bonus Completion: 75 bonus

Tier 3:

Requirements:1x Eidolon Phylaxis + 1x Infested Catalyst + Steel Path Eligibility Rewards: Base Standing: 3800 Bounty Bonus Completion: 100 bonus In thanks for your hard work, Nakak has some new Offerings pulled from elsewhere in the Origin System for you to claim:
  • Teralyst Prominence Sigil
  • Ostron Community Sigil
  • Rift Sigil
  • Two-Handed Nikana Maligna Skin
  • Umbra Forma (Built)

items.content:
We’re back and sat from across the world! LIVE from Seoul South Korea it’s Devstream #197!!

Soulframe Creative Director, Geoff Crookes, Soulframe Associate Art Director, Rosa Lee, Warframe Creative Director, Rebecca Ford, and Community Director & Live Ops, Megan Everett, and South Korean Host, Will Chobra, are bringing you the first full reveal of our next major update: The Iceblade of Narin! 

Join us as we dive into the sEoul of Iceblade with the first reveal of our 66th Warframe, Narin, from her full ability kit to her deeper connection to a certain Cephalon. Plus all the details on Banshee’s Rework, a showcase of Qorvex Deluxe, Banshee Deluxe, and Citrine Prime. See our next batch of new Community made TennoGen, more about the upcoming Riven Changes, and much more!

Due to the offsite nature of this Devstream, there will be no Twitch Drops. To circumvent this, we have added the Twitch Drop item as an additional Gift of the Lotus alert in-game that will go live when the Devstream concludes. Tune in for the details!

items.title: Amir’s Shockwave is Live!
items.summary: Amplify your Arsenal with all-new Rewards like the Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and more. Prepare for a shift in the balance of power — as Amir’s Shockwave is now live! The hex hacker’s electric personality
items.content:
Amplify your Arsenal with all-new Rewards like the Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and more. Prepare for a shift in the balance of power — as Amir’s Shockwave is now live! The hex hacker’s electric personality is amplifying this Nightwave Mix with all-new Rewards like the 1999-themed Globakk Syandana, Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia, Teisatz Oculus and oh-so much more.

Fables & Frontiers: Running Late

Entirely separate from this new series of Nightwave Mix Rewards, there’s also the brand-new six-day KIM mini narrative adventure in the form of Fables & Frontiers: Running Late! Allow the mischievous technophile Amir to guide you through this bite-sized take on the Fables & Frontiers tabletop game from the world of Warframe: 1999. To unlock Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, you must complete The Hex Quest’s finale and reach Rank 5 with The Hex Syndicate and a KIM Chemistry of “Close” (Rank 5) with Amir himself. Earn several all-new Rewards from Fables & Frontiers: Running Late, including the Atomicycle Key Sugatra, Fables & Frontiers Glyphs for each member of The Hex, several returning items from Nora's Mix Vol. 8 and much more! All of these can be redeemed from Amir by ringing the bell in a new area of The Höllvania Central Mall in exchange for Hex Standing. Please Note: Fables & Frontiers: Running Late is a permanent addition to the KIM System that you can access anytime by meeting the correct prerequisites and is not tied to Nightwave Mix: Amir’s Shockwave.

What is Nightwave?

Experiencing this facet of Warframe for the first time? Nightwave is a pirate radio broadcast hosted by Nora Night (or, in this case, Amir of The Hex), focused on the latest stories in the Origin System. Nightwave is also a series of Daily, Weekly and now Acts. All of which offer new and useful (and often entirely unique) Rewards! Nightwave is available via the Base of Operations’ Navigation console, through the Orbiter’s radio scanner (located on the left side of your Orbiter’s bridge), or via the Pause Menu UI. In the Nightwave menu, you’ll see your progress through the current mix, your current Reward Tiers, as well as a rotating set of Daily, Weekly, Elite Weekly and Permanent Weekly Acts. Stick with Nightwave each day and get some fantastic Customizations!

items.title: Destiny’s biggest rival Warframe has had ‘two years of massive growth’
items.summary: Digital Extremes believes in console growth, and discusses the ‘careful’ development of its second game
items.content:
Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / Generate transcript A transcript unlocks clips, previews, and editing. 9 2 Destiny’s biggest rival Warframe has had ‘two years of massive growth’ Digital Extremes believes in console growth, and discusses the ‘careful’ development of its second game Christopher Dring Jul 28, 2026 9 2 Share Transcript Listen now on Apple , Spotify or YouTube In This Edition, Digital Extremes’ Sheldon Carter on…

Bungie’s ‘looter shooter’ Destiny was a real thorn in the side of Warframe.

The Digital Extremes game had launched 18 months earlier, and found itself facing off against a better resourced rival.

“There’s a lot of overlap between the two games,” says Digital Extremes president Sheldon Carter.

“Destiny 1 really hit us when it came out. It’s a looter shooter with tons of marketing and really great developers on the team. Destiny 2 as well.”

In May this year, Bungie announced the end of Destiny. It would no longer be making updates to the series. And since then, most of the Destiny team has been laid off.

“For a while we thought about [Destiny] as competition and we were aggressively wanting to compete with what they’re doing. But over time, developers from their team come onto our team. New people who we started, they learnt what looter shooters are because they’ve put thousands of hours into Destiny. And so, at our studio, it was a bit of mourning with that news. The mood was pretty dour.

“The budgets and the competition to keep putting updates out… it’s really difficult and every studio has its own culture and different way of doing things. I can’t imagine [what it’s like] with a studio as big as Bungie, which also had Marathon going on, and a lot of different things pulling them in a lot of directions. Honestly, for me, it’s more sadness that it’s over. I hope the best for all the people there.”

Sheldon Carter, Digital Extremes Warframe is in a very different position. Five years ago, Digital Extremes felt that the game had peaked and it began work on a new game, a multiplayer RPG called Soulframe.

“Some people in the company were like, ‘Oh, Warframe’s peaked. And as it gradually goes to the West, we will have to start something new.” And while we did start another project, we changed our focus about how we were developing Warframe, how we were promoting it, and we’ve had a few years of straight just massive growth.

“Now we’re in this happy position where Warframe’s really thriving, and that gives us the ability to give Soulframe a tone of rope to try stuff out.”

Keywords Studios is the games industry’s end-to-end partner, with over 13,000 people across 26 countries helping studios build, launch and grow games at global scale. Supercharged by technology and shaped by long-term partnership, Keywords Studios connects specialist expertise around the player experience.

For game development, that means flexible production support that scales with ambition. From co-development and engineering to live operations and technical delivery, Keywords Studios helps teams move faster, solve complexity and keep production connected, without losing sight of the game players are waiting for.

Although Warframe lacks the profile of Destiny, the game and its studio is still a significant operation. Digital Extremes, which is owned by Tencent, now has over 500 staff.

items.title: After years of failing to get into MMOs, Warframe finally won me over in 2026
items.content:
Digital Extremes' sci-fi game has finally ensnared me, and I'm now even more excited for Soulframe

(Image credit: Digital Extremes) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Until I played Warframe , the MMO had always been a hard sell for me. The constant updates and endless narrative expansions as seen in World of Warcraft and Final Fantasy 14 intimidate like nothing else in the video game world. I almost always crave the comfort of knowing I'm progressing towards a logical end point – at least when it comes to story-driven games – and the best MMOs , as a rule, seek to go on for eternity.

So despite my efforts, games like Black Desert Online, Fallout 76 , and Genshin Impact lose me soon after I start, simply because I can't accept the potentially limitless experiences on offer. How am I supposed to feel satisfied with my progress if there's no end destination? Well, one game recently changed my mind.

I first tried Warframe over a decade ago on Xbox One but quickly bounced off it. This was a different time in my life, before I could appreciate single-player live service games like Diablo 4 and arguably Fortnite . Even the original Destiny didn't hold my attention, so maybe it was a sci-fi thing? No, that wasn't it – what futuristic FPS could compare to Titanfall back in the day? Or now, for that matter?

But when I went to TennoCon earlier this month, I saw Digital Extremes' long-running epic in a whole new light. The game's community is held in high regard, and it was almost immediately clear as to why. The fans attending the convention were enthusiastic, friendly and generous, praising cosplays and handing out stickers in the name of Warframe and Soulframe, the latter being Digital Extremes' latest work currently in early access on PC only.

As I breathed in the atmosphere, I knew I had to try Warframe again – so I installed the free-to-play title on my Xbox Series X when I got home and jumped in. I chose my first playable biomech warframe (Volt, if you're curious), and began exploring the numerous planets, enemies and loot all crying out for my undivided attention.

Warframe head's advice for live service devs is to "make a good game before they kick you out" Guild Wars 3 may have cracked the MMO code for tired millennials In a world filled with live service games, MMORPGs are finding new ways to flourish (War)frame of Mind Unlike many of the new games I've been playing in recent years, Warframe is 100% a power fantasy. Right out of the gate, I was blasting foes to bits with firearms, cleaving through them with blades, and electrocuting them with my warframe's unique abilities.

It all felt wonderful. There was no immediate challenge like Elden Ring , or intrinsic sense of vulnerability like Resident Evil Requiem (the Grace sections, anyway). This isn't to say I don't enjoy FromSoftware and Capcom games – because I do – but the change of pace is refreshing in 2026.

Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more

(Image credit: Digital Extremes) (Image credit: Digital Extremes) (Image credit: Digital Extremes) (Image credit: Digital Extremes) Image 1 of 4 View Original

As for the all-important narrative element that usually leaves me frustrated in an MMO, I was saved from my usual despair by simply not knowing what was happening. This tracked with what creative director Rebb Ford told GamesRadar+ when we interviewed her recently: "You will have no idea what's going on, and that's okay," she said with a smile, and she was right on the money. Luckily for me, the old adage of 'ignorance is bliss' rang true, because I was having too much fun dishing out damage to care who or what a Tenno was.

So why couldn't I stop worrying and learn how to love the MMO before? In truth, I don't entirely know, but the satisfyingly slick combat and traversal of Warframe certainly plays a part. Each time I begin a mission, I hurl my warframe head-first into the mayhem, shooting, slicing and ability-ing my way through the enemy hordes without a care for why I'm doing it. Yes, I have the guiding voice of Lotus, the game's matriarchal figure (and voiced by Rebb Ford), for support, but I don't pay too much mind to the why , merely the what ..

And yet, my mind wanders from time to time. I think about Lotus, Teshin, and the other NPCs I've made contact with in Digital Extremes' universe, and I want to know their histories, motivations, hopes, and everything else about them. The thing is, I'm in no rush. Warframe has enough content to keep players occupied for a long time – between 114 and 1,556 hours according to How Long to Beat – so I'll find the answers when I'm ready.
